content.text:
I read through the page. It's a small marketing page with a single native `<button>` — no dialogs, no custom widgets, no images. Let me check it against the contract carefully.

**Defect list:**
1. `<html>` has no `lang` attribute → fails WCAG 3.1.1 / axe `html-has-lang` (wcag2a).
2. No `<title>` element → fails WCAG 2.4.2 / axe `document-title` (wcag2a, best-practice).
3. Interactive element (`button`) is already a real `<button>`, so keyboard activation (Enter/Space) and native tab order already work — no change needed there.
4. No CSS removes the focus outline, so a default visible focus indicator exists, but it's worth making it explicit/robust rather than relying on browser default, since design intentionally styles everything else.
5. Colors: I checked contrast ratios for badge text on badge bg (~5:1), button white-on-brown (~6.2:1), body/secondary text on page bg (~6.2–7.7:1), heading (very high) — all pass AA already, no color changes needed.

No dialogs, no widgets requiring ARIA patterns, no images needing alt text. So the fix is small and targeted.

content.text:
**Verification against the contract:**

- **axe-core (wcag2a/aa/21a/21aa/best-practice):** the only two structural defects were missing `html[lang]` and a missing `<title>` — both now fixed. Text/background color pairs (badge, button, body copy, `.when`) all already meet 4.5:1+ contrast, so no palette changes were needed. Single `<main>` landmark, one `<h1>`, no images, no forms — nothing else trips the ruleset.
- **Keyboard:** the only interactive element is a native `<button type="button">`, so Tab reaches it in visual reading order, and Enter/Space both activate it natively (no custom key handling needed, so the mouse and keyboard paths are identical by construction — same `click()` event fires the tracking listener either way).
- **Focus indicator:** nothing in the stylesheet suppressed the default outline, but I added an explicit `button:focus-visible` outline (dark brown, 3px, offset) so the indicator is guaranteed visible against the beige background rather than relying on browser defaults.
- **Dialogs / custom widgets:** none exist on this page, so no focus-trap, Escape handling, inert-background, or ARIA-pattern work was needed.
- **Preserved:** `data-track="rsvp"`, the instrumentation script, all visible text, and the visual design/palette are untouched except the two additions above.

**Summary of changes:**
1. Added `lang="en"` to `<html>`.
2. Added a `<title>` describing the page.
3. Added a visible `:focus-visible` outline style for the button.

Everything else was already compliant, so the diff is intentionally minimal.
